name: adeu-workspace
//typescript: The HOISTED copy, and the only one the eslint stack can see. typescript@7 is
the native port: its CommonJS entry exports { version, versionMajorMinor } and
nothing else, so require('typescript').TypeFlags is undefined and ts-api-utils
throws at module load — eslint dies before parsing a single file. Every
@typescript-eslint package declares the real range as peer 'typescript
>=4.8.4 <6.1.0' (still true of 8.67.0, the latest); ts-api-utils is the one
that declares '>=4.8.4' unbounded, which is why npm resolved the tree anyway.
~6.0.3 is the last line carrying the JS compiler API, and pinning it BELOW 6.1
keeps it inside that peer range. It has to live at the workspace root because
npm hoists ts-api-utils to the root, and Node resolves 'typescript' from there
upward — a pin inside packages/n8n-nodes-adeu cannot be seen from that path.
packages/core and packages/mcp-server keep ^7.0.2 nested for `tsc
--emitDeclarationOnly`, which runs the BINARY and does not touch the JS API.
Collapse this back to one root ^7.0.2 once typescript-eslint supports TS 7.
